text: Ignore — bookkeeping marker, not a finding.

handle_saveMethodSelection's edit-right guard duplicates the sidebar's identical `$this->user->can(APIScreenRights::SCREEN_API_KEYS_METHODS_EDIT)` check in _handleSidebar(). Both are needed (UI vs server-side), but if a third call site appears, consider a small private helper (e.g. canEditMethods()) to keep the right constant reference in one place.

Second createTestAPIKeyWithRights() call site had a comment noting RIGHT_FINALIZE_MAILS intentionally omitted, documenting a rights-restriction test scenario. Since the deprecated helper already ignored $rights (delegates unconditionally to createTestAPIKeyForMethod()), that comment's premise was already stale before this migration; no test behavior changed as a result of the mechanical replacement.

handleFinalize() has its own explicit second-tier authorization check `$user->hasRight(MailRightsInterface::RIGHT_FINALIZE_MAILS)` on the API key's pseudo-user, separate from the generic getRequiredRight()/APIKeyRights::satisfies() method-grant check. Confirmed via git stash that 5 tests in SetMailingStateAPITest.php (test_finalizeWithoutGeneration, test_finalizeValidationFailure, test_finalizeValidationFailureResponseContainsValidationKeys, test_handleFinalize_allowedWithFinalizeRight, plus one more) already fail on unmodified code with error #183006 — this predates this session's migration. Root cause: the framework's createTestAPIKeyWithRights()/createTestAPIKeyForMethod() no longer set any pseudo-user rights (that behavior was intentionally dropped by the parent plan 2026-08-25-api-method-right-grants), but this HCP Editor method still gates on pseudo-user rights directly for the finalize sub-action. Needs either (a) a new test helper that also grants pseudo-user rights, or (b) migrating handleFinalize()'s check to the method-grant model (e.g. a distinct SetMailingState-Finalize method/right in the index). Out of scope for this plan — flagging as a pre-existing regression for a follow-up plan.

Working tree had pre-existing uncommitted modifications unrelated to this session (.context/framework/**, composer.json, composer.lock, api/openapi.json, docs/agents/project-manifest/module-glossary.md, docs/agents/project-manifest/modules-overview.md, personas/docs/persona-design-guide.md, storage/admin/sitemap.php) discovered via `git stash`/`git status` while isolating this session's own changes. Not touched or caused by this plan; flagging so the user can review/commit or discard them separately.

Stub does not implement APIKeyMethodInterface::getRequiredRight(), which is now a mandatory abstract method (introduced by the parent plan 2026-08-25-api-method-right-grants). This is a pre-existing fatal error (confirmed unmodified by this session via git status) that crashes the entire PHPUnit process when `composer test-suite-unit -- comtypes` is run, since VariationAPITraitTest.php lives under tests/MailEditorTests/Comtypes/ and is included in that suite. Blocked running the comtypes suite as a whole for this plan's verification; worked around by running the 15 migrated test files individually instead. Needs a getRequiredRight() implementation added to the stub (e.g. returning null or a stub constant) as a follow-up fix.
